start.text: Day two. Yesterday's thief is locked out, and the office is quiet. Too quiet for a Monday.
start.name: Joshua

B.text: IT desk, this is Joshua. How can I help?
B.name: Joshua

C.text: Joshua? It's Ben Nguyen. My laptop is crawling, and strange windows keep popping up. It has been like that since lunch.
C.name: Ben

D1.text: Hmm. Nothing special. I paid an invoice that came by email. I opened the file, and then the trouble began.
D1.name: Ben

D2.text: Yes, it's plugged in, and I restarted it twice. It's still slow. I opened an invoice earlier, but that can't be it, right?
D2.name: Ben

E.text: A slow laptop can have many boring causes. I need evidence, not guesses. Don't open anything else, Ben. I'll look into it.
E.name: Joshua

F.text: Thank you. Please hurry. I have a deadline!
F.name: Ben

G.text: Every program, download and message leaves a record somewhere. I only have to know where to look.
G.name: Joshua

H.text: [b][color=green]4 clues[/color][/b] should be enough to show what really happened. Then I'll write it all up in my report.
H.name: Joshua
